code_challenges_tenant_isolation.name: code_challenges_tenant_isolation
code_challenges_tenant_isolation.using:
EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM interview_packs ip
        WHERE ip.id = "code_challenges"."pack_id"
          AND ip.tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::uuid
      )

users_auth_lookup.name: users_auth_lookup
users_auth_lookup.using: current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) IS NULL OR current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) = ''

interview_questions_tenant_isolation.name: interview_questions_tenant_isolation
interview_questions_tenant_isolation.using:
EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM interview_packs ip
        WHERE ip.id = "interview_questions"."pack_id"
          AND ip.tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::uuid
      )
